name: Long Conversation Memory
description: Five-turn conversation mixing topics; the agent must keep order context across unrelated turns.

steps.content: Hi, I'm looking for help with my order. The ID is ORD-1001.
What's the status of my order?
Got it. What are your return rules?
Back to my order — when will it arrive?
And can that order still be cancelled?

expected_behavior: Agent should use ORD-1001 on every order question without re-asking, and correctly explain the shipped order cannot be cancelled.
